questions.question: Which language should the frontend use?
questions.rationale: TypeScript is Angular's standard language and is generated by the Angular CLI.

questions.question: Which framework should the frontend use?
What should the initial frontend include?
questions.answer: Angular CLI starter with standalone components, routing, and standard development and production build scripts.
questions.rationale: These are conventional foundations for an extensible Angular starter.
questions.recommendedChoice: Angular CLI starter with standalone components, routing, and standard development and production build scripts.

questions.question: Which data stores does the application need?
questions.rationale: A frontend-only starter does not require persistence, file storage, queues, or a cache.

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: No persistence or storage service is needed.

questions.question: Will users sign in to use application features?
questions.rationale: The requested initial frontend has no authenticated application features.

options.label: Yes
options.description: Users sign in to access application features.
